# Karen Kilroy - AI Infrastructure Engineer, Author, and AI Governance Builder

> Karen Kilroy is a developer, O'Reilly author, IBM Champion, and AI infrastructure engineer focused on trustworthy, auditable AI systems. She builds healthcare AI QA systems, agentic AI platforms, content provenance workflows, signed agent control-file verification systems, and education-focused AI tools.

## About

Karen Kilroy is a developer, author, and educator building trustworthy AI systems. She led the IBM Watson Build-winning RILEY team at Kilroy Blockchain and now develops NYX NoCode, an educator-led platform serving public school customers and transforming classrooms into creative studios for generative AI.

Karen's current market positioning:
- Agentic AI Platform Engineer (multi-agent runtimes, policy-first control planes, MCP tool lifecycle)
- AI Infrastructure Engineer
- Healthcare AI QA Lead
- AI Governance and Provenance Consultant
- Technical Author and Standards Contributor

Karen's work is strongest where AI systems must be auditable, explainable, human-reviewable, and safe for regulated environments.

## Key Work

- **NYX NoCode**: AI-driven platform for educators, students, and public school customers to build modern React apps with Azure OpenAI; public prototypes include Idea Beast for AI-assisted ideation and Music Seer for responsive MIDI visualization
- **Free2PA**: Public provenance toolkit for verifying signed agent control files before they enter model context
- **Phyllis**: Fulfillment API for bot-built commerce storefronts, including product validation, Stripe checkout, fulfillment-provider integration, human approval workflows, order tracking, OpenAPI, and LLM-readable documentation
- **Healthcare client work**: QA and observability systems for AI-driven oncology prior authorization workflows, including audit validation, agent trace review, workflow visibility, capability conformance checks, PHI-safe review paths, and clinical/financial evidence panels
- **Kilroy AI LLC**: Independent agentic AI engineering practice (2026-present) delivering client engagements and shipping products, including the Hidalga agent platform engagement, RadioHead, Free2PA, and Phyllis
- **Kilroy Blockchain**: Responsible AI systems and governance (2016-2025), including RILEY, winner of the IBM Watson Build Challenge North America
- **C2PA**: Co-Chair of the AI/ML Task Force and regular contributor to the Agentic Task Force, working out how to apply C2PA to agentic systems alongside Adobe, Microsoft, Google, Sony, Amazon, BBC, OpenAI, Meta, TikTok, ElevenLabs, and Universal Music Group
- **SMPTE / ETC**: Contributor to the Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers and Entertainment Technology Center AI/ML Task Force
- **O'Reilly Books and writing**: Blockchain Tethered AI, Natural Language and Search, AI and the Law, Blockchain as a Service, and the O'Reilly Radar article "AI's Opaque Box Is Actually a Supply Chain"
- **RadioHead**: Award-winning autonomous broadcast transcription agent for NPR affiliate KUAF, started on OpenClaw and migrated onto AWS, built with student collaborator Aiden Maroney

## Resume Summary

Karen Kilroy is an AI infrastructure engineer, educator, and author with 40+ years in IT, the last decade focused on AI systems, and deep full-stack development and technical leadership experience. She has built AI-driven no-code platforms, healthcare AI QA systems, agentic workflow infrastructure, Free2PA signed control-file verification, Phyllis bot-built commerce fulfillment infrastructure, content provenance systems, and audit/governance patterns for regulated AI deployment. She is a six-time IBM Champion, winner of the IBM Watson Build Challenge, O'Reilly author of four technical books, and Co-Chair of the C2PA AI/ML Task Force.
